description_sq:
Super mundesi per te jetuar ne nje vend te qete dhe te gjelberuar, larg zhurmave dhe ajrit te ndotur te qytetit.
Nje mundesi ideale per ata qe kerkojne qetesi, komoditet dhe nje ambient te gjelber larg zhurmave te qytetit, por prane gjithckaje te nevojshme !
Shtepia ndodhet ne nje nga zonat me te preferuara te Pezes, me gjelberim rreth e qark, ajer te paster dhe nje atmosfere relaksuese.
Zona eshte shume e qete dhe vetem pak metra larg rruges kryesore, duke ofruar akses te shpejte dhe te lehte.
Shtepia eshte nje kateshe dhe organizohet ne hyrje te shtepise me veranden, me pas eshte ambjenti i ndenjes, ambjent gatimi i vecuar, dy dhoma gjumi dhe nje tualet i bollshem.
Kjo prone ka hapesira toke gjelberuese para dhe mbrapa saj.
Ka nje komunitet te zgjedhur prane.
Detaje mbi pronen:
Ndertim i ri, modern dhe funksional
Siperfaqe neto: 97.9 m2
Verande komode: 23.7 m2
Siperfaqe totale : 121.6 m2
Siperfaqe totale parcele: 424 m2
Oborr i gjelberuar dhe ambient i mrekullueshem per familjen tuaj
Prona aktualisht eshte njekateshe por ka prespektive zhvillimi deri ne 3-4 kate, duke e bere nje investim te zgjuar per te ardhmen.
Dokumentacion i rregullt, gati per shitje dhe kalim pronesie te menjehershem.
Per me shume informacion ose per te organizuar nje vizite ne prone, na kontaktoni ne mesazh privat ose ne numrin e telefonit.
title_en: PRIVATE HOUSE FOR SALE IN PEZE-HELMES!!!
description_en: Great opportunity to live in a quiet and green place, away from the noise and polluted air of the city. An ideal opportunity for those looking for peace, comfort and a green environment away from the noise of the city, but close to everything necessary! The house is located in one of the most favorite areas of Peza, with greenery all around, clean air and a relaxing atmosphere. The area is very quiet and only a few meters away from the main road, offering quick and easy access. The house has one floor and is organized in the entrance of the house with the veranda, then there is the living room, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms and a spacious bathroom. This property has green spaces in front and behind it. There is a select community nearby. Details about the property: New, modern and functional construction Net area: 97.9 m2 Comfortable veranda: 23.7 m2 Total area: 121.6 m2 Total plot area: 424 m2 Green yard and wonderful environment for your family The property is currently one storey but has prospects of development up to 3-4 floors, making it a smart investment for the future. Regular documentation, ready for sale and immediate transfer of ownership. For more information or to organize a visit to the property, contact us in a private message or on the phone number.
